newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin to lower rates in October.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin to lower rates in October.

text.p: The Mexican development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin) said on Monday it would lower its lending rate in pesos to 30.20 percent in October, down 39 basis points from September.
Nafin said in a news release that its interest rates have not fallen as much as other leading rates such as those for Cetes, the CPP, the TIIE and the TIIP.
"Nonetheless, we hope that in the coming months this reduction can continue," Nafin said.
Nafin said its rate was competitive because it was about 400 basis points higher than the TIIE, a 28-day interbank lending rate.
